title: Anthropic Workflows
motto: Schluntz and Zhang (Anthropic, Dec 2024) distinguish workflows (predefined paths) from agents (dynamic tool-use). Five workflow patterns cover most cases. Start with direct API calls. Add agents only when steps cannot be predicted.

steps.title: Core idea
steps.body: Schluntz and Zhang (Anthropic, Dec 2024) distinguish workflows (predefined paths) from agents (dynamic tool-use). Five workflow patterns cover most cases. Start with direct API calls. Add agents only when steps cannot be predicted.

steps.title: Why this matters
cards: Teams reach for multi-agent frameworks for problems that want a single function call. The cost is real: frameworks add layers that obscure prompts, hide control flow, and invite premature complexity. Schluntz and Zhang's Dec 2024 post is the most-cited industry pushback: start simple, add complexity only when it earns its cost.

steps.title: Implement workflow
steps.body: Write the function from scratch in the workspace. Run when ready — all tests must pass.
